mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_document_version (id, document_id, version_no, version_type, source_object_id, editor_id, content_hash, version_status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{version.id}), HEXTORAW(#{version.documentId}), #{version.versionNo}, #{version.versionType}, HEXTORAW(#{version.sourceObjectId}), HEXTORAW(#{version.editorId}), #{version.contentHash}, #{version.versionStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.document_id) AS documentId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, RAWTOHEX(v.editor_id) AS editorId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.version_status AS versionStatus FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.source_object_id = HEXTORAW(#{sourceObjectIdHex})
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM edudoc_document_version WHERE document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.document_id) AS documentId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, RAWTOHEX(v.editor_id) AS editorId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.version_status AS versionStatus FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND v.version_no = #{versionNo}

SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.document_id) AS documentId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, RAWTOHEX(v.editor_id) AS editorId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.version_status AS versionStatus FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})
